description: This file contains the implementation of the ProfileReader class, which retrieves user profile information from the database, including follow status, mapped to a response envelope.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading and returning user profile data, including follow status, from the database.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user profile by username, throws exceptions if not found, maps to a Profile object, and indicates if the current user follows the profile.
